# B06 — Make conversation reach real work

[START](../../guide/00-START.md). Depends: B05. Read [VISION](../../guide/01-VISION.md) and [CONNECTIONS](../../guide/02-CONNECTIONS.md).

Existing callers: HTTP conversation route and `server/voice/live/session.ts`. Planned files: `server/conversation/coordinator.ts`, `response-frame.ts`; tests under `tests/conversation/`.

## Slices

- **s1:** Define routing output: converse, accept_work, read_work, view_intent, correct_memory, control_work, clarify. Resolve pronouns from recent conversation/job references. Reuse existing identity checks; one turn must never dispatch through both old and new paths.
- **s2:** Create ResponseFrame from scoped memory and durable work evidence. Accept a job before acknowledging it. A completed claim requires verified outcome IDs; missing evidence produces uncertainty, not invented completion. Conversation fast path avoids five serial model calls where unnecessary.
- **s3:** Wire both text and voice to the same coordinator. Keep history in existing conversation repositories. Separate short spoken response, artifact references and view intents. Stop speech and cancel work remain distinct.

Test paraphrases, missing tools, empty backlog, ambiguous dates, preferred address and repeated request ID. Greeting preferences are per user, not hardcoded responses for fixture strings.

## Gate

J01–J03 pass through real routes and DB effects. Accepted work outlives the request. No-action turn cannot claim a new completed job. Read status never creates work.

Next: B07/s1. Preserve regression tests for existing reminders while routing changes.
